HUMANOID BATTLE-MECH: IRONCLAD VANGUARD — a towering bipedal brick mech with broad SNOT-plated pauldrons, ball-jointed arms ending in a stud-cannon forearm and a three-fingered claw, a trans-cyan power-core set in a CCBS chest-shell, a visored Technic-pin head on a ball-joint neck, the dominant hero silhouette.

QUADRUPED WALKER: STONECRAWLER BASTION — a four-legged brick walker on thick Technic-beam legs braced wide, a central armored hull-pod of layered SNOT panels, a dorsal twin-stud-shooter mount, hydraulic-piston greebles at every knee joint, a low armored sensor-mast, the heavy crawling hero silhouette.

TRANSFORMER MID-SHIFT: AXIOM CONVERTER — a brick mech caught mid-transformation between jet-chassis and robot, SNOT-plated wing-panels folding outward, a single ball-jointed arm half-emerged from a fuselage shell, Technic-hinge joints exposed along the torso seam, trans-cyan connector-seams glowing at every fold-point, the in-between hero silhouette.

EXO-SUIT POWER-LOADER: BRACEFRAME LIFTER — a chunky industrial exo-suit with an open Technic-bar roll-cage cockpit cradling a pilot minifig, oversized hydraulic claw-arms on double-ball-joint shoulders, a wide caterpillar-tread base, hazard-yellow SNOT panels trimmed in black chevron tiles, the working-loader hero silhouette.

BIONICLE BIO-MECHANICAL: TAHU FORGE-WARRIOR — a bio-mechanical brick warrior on a rigid Technic axle-spine with flowing CCBS shell-armor in deep crimson and gold, a Kanohi-style noble mask on a ball-joint head, three-clawed CCBS hands gripping a bladed Technic-bar weapon, the bionic hero silhouette.

HERO-FACTORY HERO-BOT: SURGE STRIKER DELTA — a sleek heroic brick robot in ice-blue and white CCBS armor, a glowing trans-cyan hero-core set flush in the chest-shell, a multi-tool CCBS arm with a stud-shooter nozzle, a pinned visor-head on a socket joint, the clean-hero silhouette.

EXO-FORCE ANIME-MECH: GOLDEN STORM BLAZER — an angular anime-style brick mech in cobalt-blue and gold SNOT-plated armor, a sharp Technic-bar crest atop a cockpit-module head with a hair-piece pilot inside, a trans-cyan beam-saber rod arm and a dorsal shoulder-cannon, the classic rival-robots hero silhouette.

HEAVY ARTILLERY-MECH: RAMPART SIEGE-CANNON — a squat heavily-armored brick mech on splayed Technic-beam legs braced under an enormous dorsal stud-launcher barrel, ammo-feed SNOT greebles along the torso flanks, wide blast-shield SNOT-plated pauldrons, a low reinforced visor-head, the siege-platform hero silhouette.

TITAN-CLASS COLOSSUS: GRANDWALL EMPEROR — an enormous multi-tiered brick mech in layered SNOT-plate armor across a wide Technic-frame torso, trans-cyan reactor-line bricks running the full torso length, a fortress-scaled head with a recessed cockpit module, implied pilot minifigs at foot-level, the kaiju-scale hero silhouette.

SCOUT-RECON MECH: SWIFTCLAW PATHFINDER — a lean brick mech on reverse-jointed bird-legs of double-angled Technic beams, a low flat sensor-head on a ball-joint neck, compact arm-blaster CCBS tubes, twin rear thruster-pod cylinders, a crouched minimal-armor silhouette, the agile-scout hero silhouette.

SALVAGE MECH: PATCHWORK SCRAPJAW — a mismatched brick mech with exposed Technic axle-frame showing through gaps in mismatched SNOT-panel armor, a cutting-torch bar arm and a brick-built magnet-claw, visible pin-and-axle joints left unplated, salvaged tile fragments as patchwork chest armor, the junkyard-survivor hero silhouette.

AQUATIC DEEP-MECH: ABYSSAL PRESSURE-HULL — a pressure-hulled brick mech with round porthole-dome bricks at the torso, SNOT-plated fin-stabilizers on each shoulder, a harpoon-arm on a ball-joint mount, barnacle-texture greeble clusters on the lower hull, thick reinforced leg-plating, the deep-diver hero silhouette.

FLIGHT-CAPABLE JET-MECH: SKYBREAKER AERO-KNIGHT — a streamlined brick mech with swept-back SNOT-plated wing-panels on double-ball-joint shoulder pylons, a narrow visor-helm on a Technic-pin neck, forearm-mounted stud-cannon pods, a rear thruster-brick exhaust cluster, folding landing-strut legs, the flight-ready hero silhouette.

SPIDER-WALKER: HEXFANG ARACHNID — a six-legged brick walker on segmented Technic-beam limbs each ending in a claw-foot, a flat hexagonal SNOT-plated hull-carapace, a forward-mounted sensor-cluster head on a ball-joint stalk, twin underbelly stud-shooter mounts, a low predatory hero silhouette.

SIEGE-MECH: FORTRESS HAMMER — a fortress-class brick mech with a near-cubic SNOT-armored torso on wide-stance Technic-beam legs, a battering-ram forearm of stacked brick plates, a tower-shield SNOT-plate on the opposite arm, a compact reinforced visor-head, a rampart-solid hero silhouette.

CONSTRUCTION-MECH: BRICKWRIGHT BUILDER — a tall industrial brick mech with a lattice Technic-frame torso left partially exposed, a bucket-scoop claw-arm and a drill-bit Technic-bar arm, a hard-hat-brick helm on a ball-joint head, orange and grey SNOT-panel plating, the site-foreman hero silhouette.

MECH-VS-MECH DUEL-PAIR: CRIMSON BLADE AND COBALT SHIELD — two opposing brick mechs of matched scale, one with a trans-red saber-bar arm and angular SNOT-blade pauldrons, the other with a broad SNOT-plate tower-shield arm and rounded CCBS armor, each on ball-jointed bipedal Technic frames, the rival-duel hero silhouette.

BIONICLE BIO-MECHANICAL: GALI TIDE-WARDEN — a bio-mechanical brick warrior on a Technic-axle skeleton with CCBS shell-armor in deep teal and silver, a Kanohi-style great-mask head on a ball-joint, twin hook-blade arms on socket joints, elemental-blue trans-stud accents at chest and wrists, the aquatic bionic hero silhouette.

HEAVY ARTILLERY-MECH: IRONWALL MORTAR-FRAME — a wide-bodied brick mech with a reinforced SNOT-plated torso bearing twin over-shoulder mortar-barrel Technic tubes, thick leg-pillar armor on splayed Technic-beam feet, ammo-drum greeble cylinders at the hip joints, a squat blast-visor head, the artillery-fortress hero silhouette.

EXO-SUIT POWER-LOADER: AURIC FRAME MINER — a barrel-chested industrial exo-suit with a transparent-canopy cockpit brick housing a pilot minifig, twin pneumatic drill-arm Technic-bar fists, reinforced SNOT-plated knee guards on wide-stance legs, gold and dark-grey panel plating, intake-greeble vents on the torso flanks, the deep-mine hero silhouette.

TITAN-CLASS COLOSSUS: STEELWALL DREADNOUGHT — an overwhelming brick mech with a multi-panel SNOT-armored chest wider than four standard mech torsos, Technic-beam limbs scaled to city-block proportions, trans-cyan reactor-core bricks inset across the abdominal plates, a recessed fortress-helm, tower-slab pauldrons, the dreadnought-scale hero silhouette.

SCOUT-RECON MECH: PHANTOM WHISPER — a razor-lean brick mech with angled SNOT-tile stealth-panels flush across the torso, reverse-jointed Technic-beam legs ending in blade-foot tiles, a flat low-profile sensor-visor head on a ball-joint, retracted arm-blaster CCBS tubes, minimal-bulk plating, the stealth-scout hero silhouette.

HERO-FACTORY HERO-BOT: PYROX BLAZE-CORE — a heroic brick robot in molten-orange and gunmetal CCBS shell-armor, a trans-orange hero-core inset in the chest-shell, a flamethrower-nozzle CCBS arm with a stud-shooter tip, a crested visor-helm on a socket-joint neck, the bold bright-hero silhouette.

EXO-FORCE ANIME-MECH: JADE THUNDER SAMURAI — an angular brick mech in jade-green and white SNOT-plate armor with a samurai-crest Technic-bar kabuto head, an open cockpit-module with a topknot-hair-piece pilot, a katana-style Technic-bar arm and a compact shoulder-mounted stud-cannon, the anime-warrior hero silhouette.

AQUATIC DEEP-MECH: NAUTILUS SIEGE-DIVER — a reinforced deep-sea brick mech with a domed porthole-brick visor-head, broad SNOT-finned shoulder-plates, a pressurized torpedo-launcher arm on a ball-joint mount, thick ballast-block leg armor, barnacle-texture SNOT greebles across the lower hull, the trench-assault hero silhouette.
